# Feature: V2 Phrase Board Build

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-07-19 -->

## Intent

When a pack includes `engineParts` (V2), bound cards use phrase slots (core/mode/tool/charge). Engine-Teile build into phrase slots; Ladungen build into charge only. Angriff/Block stay hand-only. V1 flat bind unchanged.

## Happy Path

- [x] `BoundCardInstance.phraseSlot` optional on type
- [x] `findEnginePartDef` in lookup
- [x] V2 bind: engine part → first free core→mode→tool slot
- [x] V2 bind: boost → charge slot only
- [x] V2 bind: attack/block not legal in bind phase
- [x] Invariants: max 3 phrase + 1 charge per player when V2 pack passed
- [x] Vitest with `V2_P100_PACK`; `npm run checks` green

## Edge Cases

- [x] V1 `BASE_PACK`: bind unchanged, no `phraseSlot`
- [x] Charge occupied → no fresh boost build (replace via discard only)
- [x] Three phrase slots full → no fourth engine build without discard
- [x] Engine part in hand does not crash `getLegalActions`

## Regression

- [ ] V1 `actions.test.ts` bind flow still passes
- [ ] Default solo match (BASE_PACK) unchanged

## Assumptions

- V2 gate: `Boolean(pack.engineParts?.length)`
- Slot pick KISS: first free core→mode→tool (not preferredTag yet)
- Mono/resistance/activate combat deferred to later slices
